title: 5. Delivery includes operation and support

items: Build one complete consumer path from access to useful status.
Test permissions, stale data, source failure and recovery.
Release with monitoring, support and rollback ownership.
Practise the incident and change process with the producer.

notes:
Canonical station: Capability Delivery & Operations. Use implementation-style-appropriate engineering, testing, security, release, support and operational ownership practices. The Capability Readiness & Operations Canvas connects delivery decisions to operation. The numbered sequence is a suggested teaching workflow, not an additional mandatory method process.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
